verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs state it ships a built-in web interface for chatting with models with no extra tools needed. They also describe GUI chat interactions such as hovering over a saved message to edit it, and a built-in Discover page for installing models. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the web chat UI, and deeper documentation of chat UI features such as conversation history management and in-UI model switching.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface

citations.quote: LocalAI comes with a **built-in web interface** for chatting with models, managing installations, configuring AI agents, and more, with no extra tools needed.
To correct an earlier prompt or response without running the model again, hover over the saved message and select **Edit**.
Install models from the built-in gallery (Discover page)
